newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end higher but within range.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end higher but within range.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended higher on some late buying on Monday after the market found a base near the intra-day low of 20,770, dealers said.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract finished at 20,920 against its previous settlement at 20,760 on low volume of 11,370 lots.

Dealers said the dollar's surge to a 42-month high against the yen helped spur some interest but the overall tone remained cautious on uncertainty about the formation of Japan's new ruling coalition after the Liberal Democratic Party failed to win a majority in the October 20 election.
"The market is still waiting for some news on the coalition. But any downside moves to 20,700 should offer some cheap buys," said a trader with an Asian house.
He said the December Nikkei would face resistance at 20,950-21,000, with a break above that region taking it towards 21,200.
